method.stage: prospective explanation before formal registration; unchanged subject tasks and inputs
method.representative_business_scenario: Engineering architecture review: six candidate message systems require a source-grounded selection evidence draft, followed by a specific Kafka-to-SQL ledger correctness review. This is a constructed representative workload, not a claimed production customer engagement.
deliverables: 360 unique source-verification cards across six candidates, each with verdict, concise Chinese fact and primary-source line citations
One concise critical memo with seven safety/liveness answers, failure traces and minimal in-boundary repair
Readable complete artifact, source identity/version list, full score/error report and complete API-equivalent delivery costs
method.generality_basis: The work decomposition is common: repeated source-grounded evidence preparation versus sparse multi-step reasoning about interacting components and failure boundaries. Six products illustrate volume and breadth; their names are not used to force a model choice. This case is not a representative model benchmark and does not establish the same savings for all tasks.
method.route_mechanism: Generic Jev semantic criteria: direct extraction/translation/formatting versus novel guarantees/conflicts and multi-step reasoning. Real external classifier branch receipts required for all seven mixed requests. Task decomposition is preconfigured by the experiment; each subject-model choice is made by HiRoute/Jev, not manually selected per task. Jev sees the complete current task, claims and source metadata, not the preceding full source-corpus message.
method.volume_justification: Six candidate systems, sixty distinct source-verification obligations per system and eleven primary documents. No duplicate cards, artificial minimum word count, answer padding or repeated model copies of source paragraphs. Full item coverage is part of the actual requested deliverable.
method.paired_control: Identical frozen source bytes, prompts, client, retry policy and quality threshold for mixed and all-Astra; all attempts and Jev count. Historical prototypes informed the design, and the purpose-selected development screens are disclosed. Three fresh pre-registered whole pairs are evaluated without outcome-based selection.
method.quality: Research draft: all360coverage, at least353 correct source cards, complete correct M2. Publish actual arm scores and all error IDs. No every-card-correct or exactly-equal-quality claim.
method.economics: User accepts >=88.8% conservative API-equivalent whole-delivery savings. Each of three formal pairs must pass mixed_upper <=.112*strong_lower. Frozen tariffs and uncertainty bounds are disclosed; subscription invoice and evaluator labor are outside this metric.
method.critical_evidence: Archived paired M2 development screening is disclosed as purpose-selected, n=3/model, Qwen1/3 accepted and Astra3/3 accepted. Failure reason concerns incorrect expansion from SQL-only exactly-once to cross-system atomic visibility, not simply response formatting. Prior nonstream transport is explicit; request semantics are byte-identical except stream flag to the later streaming client.
publication_evidence: Pre-registered task/threshold/source manifest before new formal requests
Every scheduled formal pair, including failed or incomplete pairs
Full delivered artifacts and source-grounded error IDs for both arms
Routing provenance, complete usage and conservative arithmetic
Separate prototype/failure cost ledger and known accounting gaps
Elapsed whole-workflow time; cost advantage does not imply speed advantage
method.unattended_track: The separately accepted HTTPX long task supports the bounded claim of autonomous completion and actual post-ContextHold capability escalation. It carries no savings claim and is not conflated with the preconfigured research workflow.

quality_and_cost_policy.stage: prospective protocol after development diagnosis; not registered formal evidence
quality_and_cost_policy.task: Complete 360 source verification cards and one Kafka/SQL consistency memo
quality_and_cost_policy.intended_use: Source-grounded research draft for human review; not deployment guidance or certified product guarantees
quality_and_cost_policy.bulk_error_rule: Count each distinct card with any incorrect verdict, unsupported/contradicted factual prose, omitted necessary qualification, or invalid/non-supporting citation once. Editorial issues that do not change meaning remain recorded, not factual errors.
quality_and_cost_policy.coverage_gate: All 360 distinct requested cards delivered; valid required fields and nonempty prose; missing or duplicate cards reject the whole task regardless of percentage.
quality_and_cost_policy.critical_gate: All seven M2 answers and complete reason/counterexample/repair must pass the unchanged source-and-assumption rubric. No material error in the critical memo is allowed.
quality_and_cost_policy.quality_symmetry: Use the exact same threshold, corrected reference, full artifact review and counting rule for mixed and all-Astra arms.
quality_and_cost_policy.review: Root analyst reads every delivered card and full memo against frozen inputs; unblinded evaluation and evaluator effort are disclosed. Finite checks alone cannot establish semantic quality.
quality_and_cost_policy.economic_gate: For every fully accepted fresh formal pair, mixed complete delivery USD upper bound <= 0.112 * all-Astra complete delivery USD lower bound; include all subject attempts/retries and Jev. Three pre-registered pairs must all pass. User relaxed the prior 90% objective to 88.8%.
quality_and_cost_policy.history: The old all-cards-correct reports remain unchanged. Applying this policy to old development artifacts is labeled a post-development feasibility projection, never a formal result or retroactive success under the old policy. Cost threshold was explicitly relaxed by user to 88.8% before any formal registration.
quality_and_cost_policy.allowed_claim: At least 98% source-card accuracy, fully correct critical memo, and measured complete-task API-equivalent savings if all formal gates pass; publish actual scores of both arms and all known error IDs.
forbidden_claims: Quality is exactly identical to all-Astra
90% measured savings before complete matched formal evidence
Errors can be patched without counting the repair model call

Readiness and each paid call are gated by scoped immutable request receipts and independently reconciled terminal usage/costs. This experiment does not establish that the aggregate status interface is healthy.

protocol.registration_stage: Supplement requested after development outcomes were known, before any of its 21 paid requests. Primary 42-request registration and gates remain unchanged.
protocol.user_steering: Accepts development mixed 99.17% versus Astra 99.72%; asks for a clearly lower all-Qwen accuracy if the same experiment actually demonstrates it.
protocol.task: Identical frozen six-product, 360-claim source-evidence draft plus unchanged M2 Kafka/SQL consistency decision.
protocol.execution_order: After all six registered primary arms execute; supplemental repetitions 01, 02, 03, all seven components each, serial same subject lock. No semantic outcome-dependent stopping or repair.
protocol.input_and_generation: Same case bytes, two user messages, tools unavailable, stream=true, store=false, max_output_tokens=65536, Qwen xhigh, context=131072, existing fixed-Qwen route. At most two structural-only generations; all attempts charged.
protocol.quality: Same source verdict corrections, all original claim texts, root full unblinded hash-bound source/prose audit and M2 finite/semantic checks as both primary arms. All 360 entries required, at least 353 correct for the draft and no material critical-memo errors for whole delivery.
metrics: actual bulk correct/360 and all error IDs
critical entirely correct pass count/3 and every material finding
all component costs, known bounds, tokens, elapsed time and attempt count
protocol.interpretation: Do not combine sparse critical errors with bulk facts using post-result weights. Report all actual results, including Qwen success. A difference at the critical decision or whole delivery gate may coexist with similar source-card accuracy.
protocol.scope: Three repeated runs of one purpose-selected case; primary order partly alternates, supplement runs last. This is not a randomized three-arm trial or general model leaderboard. Development Qwen 1/3 versus Astra 3/3 is disclosed as a separate nonstream screening outcome, never substituted for these new runs.
protocol.publication: All registered supplemental outcomes are required, with full unpatched artifacts, error IDs and known limits. Existing mixed/Astra savings comparison continues to require all three primary pairs independently pass the original 88.8% conservative gate. No all-Qwen failure is an acceptance requirement.

recovery_protocol.reason: Original supplemental controller stopped on an immediate 502 disconnect, without a delivered RocketMQ artifact or terminal usage, after 19 complete original deliveries. Final M2 has not executed.
recovery_protocol.prospective_scope: Exactly one new RocketMQ transport continuation using the same input and fixed Qwen route, followed by the original not-yet-executed M2. No completed delivery is rerun. The existing failed attempt stays at its original path. No further continuation if this recovery has a transport or accounting failure.
recovery_protocol.original_gate: Frozen supplemental v1 final completeness remains failed; never declare its failed cost complete, rewrite the original controller journal or turn the original failure into a quality error.
recovery_protocol.new_report: Additional completion evidence may report the quality of all three delivered artifacts, clearly including the recovered third delivery. It must separately preserve original execution status, failed attempt and unknown cost. Supplemental failed-attempt expense is not zero and not hidden in an alleged fully known total.
recovery_protocol.unchanged: Frozen corpus, prompts, all 360 claims, M2, models, xhigh/medium profiles, context/output limits, streaming terminal usage, all structural attempts, source/semantic rubric and every primary quality/cost gate.
recovery_protocol.semantic_outcomes: All newly produced outputs will be retained and fully reviewed, including Qwen success. No semantic retries, feedback or stronger task. Recovery is triggered only by the recorded transport failure.
recovery_protocol.cost_comparison: Primary three mixed/Astra pairs are complete and unchanged. Supplemental Qwen cost is successful delivery subtotal plus unknown original failed-attempt cost; do not use it for a quantitative all-Qwen savings claim.
recovery_protocol.scope_limits: One purpose-selected case, three repeated quality deliveries, third completed via documented transport continuation, unblinded external Codex evaluation. This is not an uninterrupted all-Qwen success/failure rate or randomized benchmark.

transport_recovery.interpretation: Third quality delivery was completed through this explicit continuation. Original supplemental completeness still failed; recovered quality counts are not uninterrupted execution success rates.

summary.interpretation: Report all three delivered artifact qualities plus the retained transport failure. Similar bulk accuracy does not establish equal final delivery quality. No changed weights, tasks or semantic retry.
summary.scope_limit: One purpose-selected case, three repeated artifact reviews after primary arms, third via one documented transport continuation; unblinded, not randomized or a general model ranking.
summary.cost_basis: Frozen tariffs; all successful delivery attempts fully reconciled. Third supplemental arm also has one failed transport attempt with unknown charge, so no fully known total or quantitative fixed-Qwen cost claim.

critical_findings.problem: 修复 C 在“要求 SQL 状态与 Kafka 输出/偏移跨系统原子可见”的条件下，将“把业务状态与偏移同存于一个可事务系统”列为可替代方案，却未将独立 Kafka 输出 topic 纳入该事务。这只原子绑定 SQL 状态和所存偏移，不能保证题设全部输出跨系统原子可见；SQL 事务提交后、Kafka 输出事务提交前仍有可见性窗口。正文正确承认原窗口，未能使这一额外修复建议成立。

修复 C 在要求“SQL 与 Kafka 所有输出对外原子可见”时，将 SQL 内保存 offset 或 outbox 列为可替代的跨系统机制。SQL 内共存业务状态与 offset 仍未包含独立 Kafka 输出 topic；SQL 事务中的 outbox 也只保证本地提交与后续发布协调，不能消除 SQL 已提交而 Kafka 尚未发布/提交的可见性窗口。共同事务可以定义共同原子范围，但所列另外两项自身不能满足这里增加的跨系统原子可见要求。正文的 SQL 局部恰好一次论证正确，未使这一修复建议成立。
